//: Lives in frontend/ ; set Vercel Project 'Root Directory' = frontend. Vite build (npm run build) -> dist, auto-detected.

rewrites.//: Proxy API calls to the FastAPI backend (Render/Railway). Replace the host with your deployed backend URL. Frontend calls relative /api/* so no frontend env var is needed.
SPA fallback: send client-side routes (e.g. /dashboard) to index.html. Real static files (/assets/*, /data/*.json) are served from the filesystem first, so this does not clobber them.
